## Catalog Products

- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/catalog-products/v1/products-create/): Creates a product.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/catalog-products/v1/products-patch/): Updates a product, by ID. You can patch these attributes and objects: AuthorizationBearer <token>
